name: intention-audience
ideaZh: 整齐的座位与重复的人物，形成集体观看的层次。
ideaEn: Repeated seats and figures organize collective attention.

name: intention-environment-arena
ideaZh: 环形站位、场地边界与看台，共同建立空间关系。
ideaEn: A ring of figures, arena boundary, and stands establish spatial relations.

name: intention-plot-back-to-the-future
title: 《回到未来》 / Back to the Future
ideaZh: 人物的视线与抬起的手，把注意力引向高处的物件。
ideaEn: The gaze and raised hand direct attention toward the elevated object.

name: intention-character-forrest-gump
title: 《阿甘正传》 / Forrest Gump
ideaZh: 居中的坐姿、双手与周围留白，让身体姿态清楚可读。
ideaEn: A centered seated pose, hands, and surrounding space make posture legible.

name: intention-mood-fight-club
title: 《搏击俱乐部》 / Fight Club
ideaZh: 重复的面部轮廓与大片暗部形成不稳定的观看感。
ideaEn: Doubled facial contours and broad shadows unsettle the view.

name: intention-theme-cross
ideaZh: 斜坡与交叉的木梁建立方向；符号意义还需语境支持。
ideaEn: A slope and crossing beams establish direction; symbolic meaning still needs context.

name: character-cover-overlapping-faces
title: 《指环王》系列 / The Lord of the Rings series
ideaZh: 三张脸被压进狭窄空间，轮廓重叠但视线并不相同。
ideaEn: Three faces occupy a tight field; contours overlap while gazes differ.

name: character-association-baby-driver
title: 《极盗车神》 / Baby Driver
ideaZh: 人物抬手的动作与身后的大幅图形发生视觉呼应。
ideaEn: The raised arm visually echoes the large graphic behind the person.

name: character-repetition-profiles
zh: 重复：相近的侧面与朝向
ideaZh: 两张侧面沿同一方向展开，构成可比较的视觉模式。
ideaEn: Two profiles facing a similar direction establish a comparable pattern.

name: character-mirroring-horse
ideaZh: 人和马的头部靠近，接触与相近层次共同建立关系。
ideaEn: Nearby heads, contact, and a shared depth establish a relation.

name: character-unity-baby-driver
title: 《极盗车神》 / Baby Driver
ideaZh: 人物轮廓在中间叠压，背景的重复圆形构成另一层节奏。
ideaEn: The figures overlap centrally; repeating circles form a second rhythm behind them.

name: character-distance-figure-and-artwork
title: 《丹麦女孩》 / The Danish Girl
ideaZh: 左侧坐着的人物与右下方作画者分处两端；中央画作又把人物的不同形象联系起来。
ideaEn: The seated figure at left and painter at lower right occupy opposite sides; the central painting links different representations of the figure.

name: character-high-angle
title: 《低俗小说》 / Pulp Fiction
ideaZh: 从高处看人物，周围直线向身体附近汇聚。
ideaEn: Seen from above, surrounding lines converge near the body.

name: character-low-angle-django
en: Low angle: foreground and background scale
title: 《被解救的姜戈》 / Django Unchained
ideaZh: 近处的头部占据画面，远处站立者以较小尺度进入上方。
ideaEn: A near head fills the frame while a smaller standing figure occupies the upper distance.

name: character-eyeline-off-axis
en: Eyeline: away from the lens axis
title: 《楚门的世界》 / The Truman Show
ideaZh: 倾斜的脸与横向身体组织方向；先分清头部朝向与实际视线。
ideaEn: A tilted face and horizontal body establish direction; distinguish head angle from actual gaze.

name: character-eyeline-through-blinds
title: 《亡命驾驶》 / Drive
ideaZh: 百叶窗反复切割画面，露出的眼睛成为注意点。
ideaEn: Repeated blind slats divide the image; the visible eyes become an attention point.

name: character-hero-django
en: Hero framing: center and negative space
title: 《被解救的姜戈》 / Django Unchained
ideaZh: 直立人物接近中心；环境保留可读的开阔空间。
ideaEn: The upright figure sits near center with readable open space around him.

name: character-profile-window
ideaZh: 额头、鼻、下颌与脖颈的折线，在明亮窗口前被显露。
ideaEn: Forehead, nose, chin, and neck become legible against a bright window.

name: character-effects-brooklyn
title: 《布鲁克林》 / Brooklyn
ideaZh: 浅淡背景与面部边缘的柔化，可作为研究主观感受的线索。
ideaEn: Pale surroundings and softened facial edges offer a cue for studying subjective experience.

name: character-effects-carol
title: 《卡罗尔》 / Carol
ideaZh: 反射圆斑与暗部叠在侧面之前，使观看带有一层隔膜。
ideaEn: Reflected circles and shadows sit before a profile, adding a layer between viewer and figure.

name: character-beginnings-closeup
title: 《布鲁克林》 / Brooklyn
ideaZh: 把人物面部、画面边界和后景人物的层次分别标出。
ideaEn: Mark the face, frame edge, and background figure as separate layers.

name: character-endings-group
zh: 首尾研究：群体中的人物
en: First–last study: a figure in a group
title: 《严肃的男人》 / A Serious Man
ideaZh: 群体中的中心人物与周围人群形成尺度和清晰度的区别。
ideaEn: A central figure differs from the surrounding crowd in scale and clarity.
